Auto-answered by the orchestrator clarify-respond workflow.

DECISIONS:
Q1: B
Q2: A
Q3: B

RATIONALE:
Q1: Under B, the hold applies only to plans whose planned files include automation paths, so ordinary plans keep the current `AUTO_IMPLEMENT_ON_CLEAR_PLAN` behaviour (`.github/workflows/plan.yml:2126-2138`). It also allows both regressions the issue asks for (an ungranted security finding is held, a granted plan is approved), because the grant check runs once the flag is set to `true`. A would stop auto-approval across the whole repo and rule out the "granted plan" regression. C would not suppress anything while the flag is off, which goes against "suppress automatic /approved posts ... while it is off".
Q2: `main` already has the automation-path guard that the gate needs to reuse: `is_automation_path` (line 164), `build_automation_grant` (line 177) and `check_automation_paths` (line 212) in `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`, behind exit code 30. "Backport ... to stable as needed" is met by the normal promote/release path. A separate backport PR (B) does not fit the one-issue, one-PR pipeline. C targets the branch that lacks the guard, which is the reason #6766 was blocked.
Q3: The staged-support latch release (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:17330`) only runs in this source repository. It re-approves an issue that was already approved and was mid-implementation. That release also passes the implementation-time automation-path guard, which stays in place. Putting a gate on it would add scope the operator step did not ask for.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
(none; every decision is a letter)

SETUP REQUIRED (only when a decision relies on a placeholder):
- AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED (variable): an operator sets it to `true` once required checks pass on the gated change. Until then, plans whose planned files include `.github/`, `.claude/`, `scripts/`, `prompts/` or `workflow-templates/` get no automatic `/approved`. This covers `plan.yml` and both the managed and standalone stall-recovery `auto_approve` paths, and each held plan is logged with an `AI_PHASE_GATE_V1` line naming the protected paths. Plans touching no protected paths behave as they do today.
